summary: Applied Owner amendment A0009 at the CONTRACT layer to exactly the seven named PLANNED contracts and to nothing else: T063, T064, T065, T066, T070, T101 and T084. git status shows those seven files modified and no other tracked file changed; todo/config.yaml is byte-identical to base, so no dependency field, status, attempt, commit SHA, evidence pointer, review record or approval datum moved, and every target is still PLANNED at attempt 0. (1) T063 resolves the manifest pool scope explicitly instead of leaving it readable both ways: a manifest is per pool - exactly one `(chain_id, PoolKey)` with that pool's own block range and interval, its own decisions, ledger, metrics and report checksums, and never another pool's - and a run covering more than one pool is one run identity over one dataset version and one reporting numeraire publishing one manifest per member pool, so the panel T101 assembles and the pool holdout T064 evaluates are selections over a run's manifest set rather than fields inside one manifest. The basis is stated in the contract: ADR-014's Consequences record that a run manifest currently holds a single `pool_id` and must be per-pool or widened before a multi-pool run is claimed, and that partitions and checkpoints are keyed by `(chain_id, contract_address, pool_id)` per row; per-pool was chosen over widened because the dataset T100 delivers already binds the member pools and each member's range, so a widened manifest would duplicate that registry. The unit requirement is now unambiguous: it covers every quantity the manifest records in both lists, not only the two fields A0003 added, so the interval, a block bound, a latency, a cost and a quote assumption carry units. One acceptance clause was appended: a multi-pool run publishes one manifest per member pool under one run identity, and a manifest that carries another pool's data or results fails validation. (2) T064 gives the halt/degrade criteria a named home. The stressed gas/latency/slippage/fee cases and the missing-data and reorg cases become a scenario catalogue, and every catalogue entry declares before the run whether its scenario halts the run with a named reason code or degrades a result to the deterministic fallback that entry names; the acceptance now checks that each failure scenario halts or degrades exactly as its entry declares and that no degrade falls through to undefined behaviour or a forced trade (`DS-041`), which also joins the References. The purge and embargo gap is now one quantity stated identically in Deliverables and Acceptance: a single length, not two, equal to the declared label horizon and derived from it; the acceptance says the gap length is derived from the declared label horizon - equal to it - rather than hand-chosen, matching DS-022 and the unchanged Must not clause. (3) T065 gains acceptance coverage for the rule that already existed in its Deliverables and in STRATEGY_ECONOMICS `ECO-REGIME-001`, without changing the rule: a golden scenario whose complete 5-minute target-token USDG return is above 100% produces no risk-increasing candidate, records the in-strategy position reassessment and changes no global run state, while an incomplete 5-minute bar does not trigger it. The References name `ECO-REGIME-001`. (4) T066 defines what locks a candidate. The Deliverables now require an immutable candidate-lock record, written before the test fold is read, freezing the candidate version and the protocol it will be judged under - parameter-set version, code revision, manifest hash, seed, declared split boundaries, cost assumptions and elimination rules - with its content hash, the actor and the lock time; the experiment harness writes and observes that record and refuses to read the test fold for a candidate version that has none, and a change to any frozen field after the lock is a new candidate version rather than an edit. The acceptance clause now says what the lock is, names the harness as the observer, requires the evaluation fold to be seen once and after the lock (`DS-031`), and DATASET_AND_EVALUATION.md (`DS-031`) joins the References. (5) T070 gains acceptance coverage for the rule that already existed in its Deliverables, in PROJECT_GOALS.md `G-EMERGENCY-01` and in OPERATOR_CONTROL.md `CTRL-MARKET-001`, without changing the rule: the complete 5-minute target-token USDG return `<= -80%` condition is tested as a strategy-independent `AUTO_EXIT` result that no strategy approval can suppress or relax, and an incomplete 5-minute bar does not trigger it. Both cited IDs are named in the References. (6) T101's sample-size disclosure is re-based on the window ADR-015 establishes: the ten-million-block window is gone from the contract, replaced by the per-pool extended-history window from each pool's own `Initialize` block to the run's agreed finalized block, with the pinned reference pool initialized about twelve days before the last probe, which at the measured 0.1008-second block interval is roughly 3.4 thousand five-minute bars or 288 hourly bars. The claim's substance - the measured sample size is the binding constraint, and a multi-pool panel is dominated by a small number of shared market regimes - is retained, and ADR-015 joins the References as where the number now comes from. (7) T084's two defects are corrected. The acceptance no longer calls T083 a P08 web-console task: it now says the P08 web-console tasks `T084`-`T086`, which is what ARCHITECTURE.md section 2.2 assigns `robinhood_lp.web` to, while T083 owns the preliminary-paper release dossier (`robinhood_lp.ops.dossier`) and carries no `WEB-*` requirement. The WEB-GLOBAL-001 dataset-version requirement is resolved by naming its P08 supplier and scoping it: the dataset version, the member block ranges and the reporting numeraire are displayed from the manifests and reports this console reads, which T063 delivers and this task already depends on, while the registry-wide question - which datasets exist, what each covers and its qualification status - belongs to the dataset registry T100 delivers in P10, so a surface with no dataset behind it shows `WEB-GLOBAL-002`'s explicit unknown/absent state rather than a value; a new body section records that scope and says which of the two offered routes was taken, the global banner deliverable now names the dataset version and reporting numeraire, one acceptance clause was added, and T063 and T100 join the References. Every pre-existing acceptance criterion, Must not clause and safety, risk, promotion and precision rule is retained; all seven Dependencies blocks and Must not sections are byte-identical to base, no task was activated and no implementation attempt was consumed. Owner adjudication of 2026-09-19, recorded in the rationale: the four items this planner had listed as unresolved are all decided - the T063/T084 dataset-version arrangement is confirmed exactly as implemented with no dependency edge on T100, and the stale ten-million-block clause in `DS-030` plus the placement of T064's halt/degrade home are registered for a separate SPEC-layer amendment rather than executed here, since docs/spec/ is outside the CONTRACT layer and only one amendment may be active at a time. That adjudication changed no contract text; it updated this result record and nothing else, so the seven target contracts and todo/config.yaml are byte-identical to the state described above. Read-only checks re-run after that update, reported as investigation evidence only and never as acceptance evidence: `python -m tools.workflow validate` returns status OK in this worktree.
rationale: Owner-direction mapping, item by item, with the repository fact each correction rests on. T063 (scope): the direction's cited fact is ADR-014's Consequences paragraph, which the contract now paraphrases in its own Basis sentence together with the storage keying recorded in the same paragraph; the manifest's existing fields stay singular (chain, PoolKey, interval), which is what makes per-pool the reading that needs no second description of the research universe, while widening would restate the member pools, their ranges and the partitions they resolve to that ADR-014 clause 4 and the T100 registry already bind; the choice is therefore recorded, not left to the Developer. T063 (unit scope): the sentence that read `each recorded with its unit where it is a quantity` could attach either to everything above or only to the two added fields; it now names the scope explicitly as both lists and every quantity, which clarifies without adding or removing a required field. T064 (halt/degrade): no specification clause defines halt or degrade for the stress, missing-data and reorg cases, so the criteria had to get a home inside the contract; the scenario catalogue is that home, each entry declares its own outcome before the run, and DS-041 supplies the repository's floor for what a degrade may never be - undefined behaviour or a forced trade - without being stretched into a universal fallback rule for stress scenarios that have no rule baseline. T064 (purge/embargo): DS-022 requires a separation band equal to the label horizon, recorded with the split and derivable from the label definition rather than hand-picked; the contract now says which quantity is derived (the gap length), from what (the declared label horizon, in the horizon's own unit) and that it is one length rather than two, so Deliverables, Acceptance and Must not agree, the word `derivable` is replaced by the single consistent statement, and no requirement was relaxed. T065 and T070: both rules already existed in those contracts' Deliverables and in the named specification clauses (ECO-REGIME-001 for the above-100-percent rule, CTRL-MARKET-001 with G-EMERGENCY-01 for the minus-80-percent breaker), and the direction asked for acceptance coverage of the existing rules and for no change to the rules themselves, so their Deliverables are byte-identical and only the Acceptances gained a scenario; the incomplete-bar negative check follows from the word `complete` in both rules and from CTRL-MARKET-001's explicit rule that an unfinished period must not trigger the breaker. T066: `until one candidate is locked` had no definition, mechanism or artifact; the definition is taken from DS-031 (the evaluation fold is seen once and only after the candidate is locked) and STRATEGY_ECONOMICS section 6 (boundaries, costs and elimination rules are declared before the final result is seen, and a threshold change creates a new version), and the lock record is the artifact that makes the acceptance clause checkable, with the harness named as the observer that enforces it. T101: ADR-015 section 5 forbids citing the ten-million-block window as the research range and records the replacement window with its measured numbers (the pinned reference pool initialized about twelve days before the last probe; roughly 3.4 thousand five-minute bars at the measured 0.1008-second interval, itself derived from 3,266 persisted headers spanning 999,704 blocks and 100,819 seconds); the paragraph now cites ADR-015 for every number, keeps the substance of the claim and removes the retired window from the contract entirely rather than restating it. T084: ARCHITECTURE.md section 2.2 is the repository's own module-to-layer mapping and it assigns `robinhood_lp.web` to T084-T086 while T083 owns `robinhood_lp.ops.dossier`; T083's contract contains no `WEB-*` requirement, so narrowing the phrase to `T084`-`T086` cannot drop coverage and only removes a false classification. For the dataset version, the direction offered naming the supplier or scoping to what P08 observes; the contract now does both and states which: the supplier is T063, already a dependency, whose manifest records the dataset version, the reporting numeraire and its valuation qualification, and the scope is P08, because the registry query surface belongs to T100 in P10 and T084's dependency set and phase position cannot supply it - P10's own entry gate requires the P08 console, so the edge cannot simply be reversed, and the recorded direction froze dependency fields in any case. No dependency field was edited in any of the seven contracts, verified by diffing each Dependencies block against base. Constraints held: the changed path set is exactly the seven target contracts; docs/intent/, docs/spec/, docs/implement/, tools/, .claude/, todo/schemas/ and the dependency manifests are untouched; the accepted ADRs and specification clauses are cited, never edited; the retired T022, T023 and T038 appear nowhere in the added text and the retired ten-million-block window is removed from T101 instead of being restated; every target keeps its Contract status line, its Dependencies block and its Must not block byte-identical to base; no URL, credential, API key, authorization header, key material or environment value was written; and git diff --check is clean. Owner adjudication of the four recorded items, 2026-09-19. This is the authorization chain the reviewer can follow, and it changed no contract text - only this result record. (a) Items 2 and 3 (T063 and T084 citing a dataset version whose issuer, the T100 registry, lands in P10) are confirmed exactly as implemented and need no contract change: the dataset version, the reporting numeraire and its valuation qualification are carried by the T063 manifest, T063 is already one of T084's dependencies, T084 displays only what P08 can observe (the manifests and reports that console reads) and shows `WEB-GLOBAL-002`'s explicit unknown/absent state where no dataset stands behind a surface instead of a value, a carried-forward version or a fabricated one, and the registry-wide query surface - which datasets exist, what each covers and its qualification status - is explicitly assigned to T100 in P10. No dependency edge on T100 is added, and that is a decision, not an omission: such an edge would run from the P06 and P08 targets forward into the P10 registry, i.e. a forward cross-phase dependency, which is a plan-structure change outside the CONTRACT layer this amendment was granted, and it would additionally invert P10's own recorded entry gate, which requires the P08 authenticated console to exist first. (b) Item 1 (DS-030 in docs/spec/research/DATASET_AND_EVALUATION.md still justifying the deliberately small model families with the retired ten-million-block window) is registered by the Owner under the same-defect-fixed-together rule and is to be handled by a separate SPEC-layer amendment: docs/spec/ was deliberately not edited here, both because this run was granted the CONTRACT layer only - the layer admits the named task contracts and their dependency fields - and because only one amendment may be active at a time, so the correction cannot ride along with this one. The same re-basing A0009 performed on T101 therefore still awaits its SPEC counterpart. (c) Item 4 (the halt/degrade home for T064) is registered in that same batch: whether the catalogue belongs in docs/spec/research/DATASET_AND_EVALUATION.md is to be decided by that later SPEC-layer amendment, and this contract keeps the scenario-catalogue home it now carries, unchanged. (d) Consequently the unresolved-question list of this record is empty: all four items the planner had flagged now have a recorded Owner ruling, two of them being deferrals to a named later route rather than open questions, and nothing else was left open. Verification performed as investigation only, never as acceptance evidence, and re-run after the adjudication update: `python -m tools.workflow validate` returns status OK in this worktree; the seven target contracts and todo/config.yaml are byte-identical to the state the summary describes (the update touched only .workflow/amendment-result.json).
